scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
